# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.3 Far Seas & Overseas Exarchates (Slot 42, oe_far_, mode=plan_b). Generated by gen_far_seas.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Calendar month index (1337.1 = 1), identical convention to oe_ml_month_now.
oe_far_m_now = {
    value = current_year
    subtract = 1337
    multiply = 12
    add = current_month
}

# Clamped one-month-of-income unit based on oe_fin_month (prevents 0-cost or overflow).
oe_far_cost_1m = {
    value = oe_fin_month
    min = 30
    max = 600
}
oe_far_cost_15m = { value = oe_far_cost_1m multiply = 1.5 }
oe_far_cost_2m  = { value = oe_far_cost_1m multiply = 2 }
oe_far_cost_25m = { value = oe_far_cost_1m multiply = 2.5 }
oe_far_cost_3y  = { value = oe_far_cost_1m multiply = 12 }
oe_far_cost_halfm = { value = oe_far_cost_1m multiply = 0.5 }

# Dynamic East envoy cost (-25% when Trajan's Canal is open).
oe_far_cost_east_envoy = {
    value = oe_far_cost_15m
    if = {
        limit = { oe_far_red_canal_open = yes }
        multiply = 0.75
    }
}
oe_far_cost_east_press = {
    value = oe_far_cost_east_envoy
    multiply = 0.5
}

# Negative gold helper values for add_gold.
oe_far_pay_1m        = { value = oe_far_cost_1m multiply = -1 }
oe_far_pay_15m       = { value = oe_far_cost_15m multiply = -1 }
oe_far_pay_2m        = { value = oe_far_cost_2m multiply = -1 }
oe_far_pay_25m       = { value = oe_far_cost_25m multiply = -1 }
oe_far_pay_3y        = { value = oe_far_cost_3y multiply = -1 }
oe_far_pay_halfm     = { value = oe_far_cost_halfm multiply = -1 }
oe_far_pay_east_env  = { value = oe_far_cost_east_envoy multiply = -1 }
oe_far_pay_east_prs  = { value = oe_far_cost_east_press multiply = -1 }

# Annual overseas strain calculation fed into oe_ar_add_strain (anti-snowball loop).
# Unchartered direct control: 0.25 * East + 0.35 * West (cap 3.5/yr);
# Chartered Exarchates halve their ocean's load (cap 1.8/yr);
# Classical Prefectures (oe_prf_mode_1 Oriens / oe_prf_mode_4 Galliae) further ease 30%.
oe_far_strain_east_part = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_n }
        add = global_var:oe_far_east_n
        multiply = 0.25
        if = {
            limit = { oe_far_has_east_exarch = yes }
            multiply = 0.5
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_mode_1 var:oe_prf_mode_1 >= 1 }
            multiply = 0.7
        }
    }
}

oe_far_strain_west_part = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_n }
        add = global_var:oe_far_west_n
        multiply = 0.35
        if = {
            limit = { oe_far_has_west_exarch = yes }
            multiply = 0.5
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_mode_4 var:oe_prf_mode_4 >= 1 }
            multiply = 0.7
        }
    }
}

oe_far_annual_strain = {
    value = oe_far_strain_east_part
    add = oe_far_strain_west_part
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                oe_far_has_east_exarch = yes
                oe_far_has_west_exarch = yes
            }
        }
        max = 1.8
    }
    else = {
        max = 3.5
    }
}

# Annual overseas autonomy drift (oe_far_auto, 0-100).
oe_far_auto_drift = {
    value = 1.0
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_n }
        add = { value = global_var:oe_far_east_n multiply = 0.4 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_n }
        add = { value = global_var:oe_far_west_n multiply = 0.4 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                at_war = yes
                AND = { has_variable = oe_ar_strain var:oe_ar_strain >= 60 }
            }
        }
        add = 1.5
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            navy_size >= 30
            has_country_modifier = oe_far_audit_cool
        }
        subtract = 1.0
    }
}

# Annual dividend added to Roman Company fund (oe_cmp_fund) from East factorias.
oe_far_cmp_east_div = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_n }
        add = global_var:oe_far_east_n
        multiply = 0.5
        multiply = oe_far_cost_1m
    }
}

# Readout script values (used in oe_far.90 and oe_far_log_dump).
oe_far_rd_on = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_on } add = 1 } }
oe_far_rd_done = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_done } add = 1 } }
oe_far_rd_east_on = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_on } add = 1 } }
oe_far_rd_west_on = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_on } add = 1 } }
oe_far_rd_east_n = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_n } add = global_var:oe_far_east_n } }
oe_far_rd_west_n = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_n } add = global_var:oe_far_west_n } }
oe_far_rd_east_ex = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_exarch } add = global_var:oe_far_east_exarch } }
oe_far_rd_west_ex = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_exarch } add = global_var:oe_far_west_exarch } }
oe_far_rd_auto = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_auto } add = global_var:oe_far_auto } }
oe_far_rd_strain = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_last_strain } add = global_var:oe_far_last_strain } }
oe_far_rd_ar = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ar_strain } add = var:oe_ar_strain } }
oe_far_rd_cnt = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_ev_cnt } add = global_var:oe_far_ev_cnt } }
oe_far_rd_m = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_ran_m } add = global_var:oe_far_ran_m } }
